title: PC froze without a usable trace on 11 October
cause: Suspected resource pressure while about 110 Chromium/Electron launches and several workers ran together; the precise cause is not proven.
pendingGuards: Ship pulse-os persistent black box, watchdog and worker caps; verify on the installed PC.

title: A laptop local commit paused the follower 86 commits behind
cause: The fast-forward follower could not advance a checkout with a local commit and did not make the pause visible.

title: Files reflected deleted disk entries
cause: The Files reflection did not refresh with disk changes; files-live work is not merged and its regression guards are not yet available here.
pendingGuards: Merge files-live and reference its actual passing disk-change regression test.

title: Usage did not read the PC memory bank
cause: Usage read local rather than authoritative PC history; usage-pc work and its regression guards are not merged.
pendingGuards: Merge usage-pc and reference its actual PC authority regression test.

title: Workers finished without anyone noticing
cause: Hand-written launchers left an exit file but no independently raised completion item.

title: PC disk reached 92 percent without a warning
cause: Build/cache accumulation filled disk with no continuous declared pressure invariant.

title: Concurrent Chromium test launches formed a resource storm
cause: Several workers and browser-heavy suites ran concurrently without a shared resource boundary or browser admission limit.
pendingGuards: Ship and verify pulse-os worker caps; app test admission now allows at most two Chromium browsers and the full suite runs serially.
